name: BELIZE

flag.title: Flag of Belize
flag.note: Blue with red stripes & white coat of arms

lead: Belize is a tiny country on the Caribbean coast. It is smaller than Wales. Yet it has Maya pyramids, jaguar rainforests, and a huge barrier reef. Around 400,000 people speak Kriol, Spanish, Maya, and Garifuna.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Belize sits on the Caribbean coast, with Mexico to the north and Guatemala to the west. The north is flat and swampy. The south rises to Doyle's Delight, a 1,124 m peak.
Offshore, a barrier reef stretches 300 km. Inside it hides the Great Blue Hole, a round sinkhole 318 m across and 124 m deep.
animals: Belize is one of the few places where jaguars still roam wild. Many live in Cockscomb Basin Wildlife Sanctuary, across 200 square miles of forest.
Baird's tapir is the national animal. It is shaped like a barrel and is as big as a small horse. Gentle manatees graze on seagrass. The keel-billed toucan is the national bird.
culture: Mestizo, Creole, Maya, Garifuna, Mennonite and East Indian communities all live here. UNESCO honoured Garifuna culture in 2001 for its language, punta drumming and dance.
The food mixes every group. Creole rice and beans, Garifuna hudut (fish in coconut broth), Maya tamales and Mennonite cheese share the same market stalls.
history: The Maya built great cities here over 2,000 years ago. Caracol, Xunantunich and Lamanai held tens of thousands of people. By 1000 AD the cities had emptied.
British logwood cutters arrived in the 1600s. The land became British Honduras in 1862. Belize became fully independent on 21 September 1981.
wows: Astronauts can see the round Great Blue Hole from space.
Belize is the only Central American country where English is official.
Two Belize dollars equal one US dollar, fixed since 1978.
Belize's barrier reef is the longest in the Western Hemisphere.
Cockscomb Basin was the world's first official jaguar preserve, set up in 1986.
Ancient Caracol was bigger than modern Belize City, with 150,000+ Maya.
Mennonite farmers drive horse-drawn buggies and supply most of Belize's dairy.

myths.myth: Coral is a kind of rock
myths.fact: Coral is made of tiny animals called polyps. They build hard cups that pile up into a reef.

myths.myth: A black panther is its own animal
myths.fact: A black panther is a leopard or jaguar with dark fur. Its spots hide in the black.
